name: What is the typical cost structure for complete remodeling project management?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical cost structure for complete remodeling project management?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost structure for complete remodeling project management can vary. Generally, it can be a percentage of the total project cost, a fixed fee, or a combination. At Frasheski Construction, we provide a detailed proposal outlining all costs associated with our project management services and the overall remodel after understanding your specific project requirements. We believe in transparent pricing with no hidden fees, ensuring you understand exactly what you're paying for.
acceptedAnswer.description: Cost structures for project management can be a percentage of the total project cost, a fixed fee, or a combination, clearly outlined in our proposal.
